The SOC curve of the battery indicates that this approach minimizes the frequency of battery charge-discharge cycles.

articleTitle: Optimization and Scheduling of Distributed Flexible Resources in Novel Power System Based on Consistency Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: The new power system integrates multiple entities such as energy suppliers, load aggregators and energy stations. There are information privacy and technical barriers between subjects, which are independent and interrelated, and some subjects can achieve two-way interaction and energy trading. The new power system for areas includes multiple distributed power sources and multiple energy supply units, and each energy supply unit is independent and coupled to each other. Aiming at the lowest power supply cost, the operation cost model of each equipment in the system is established, and the consistency algorithm is used to optimize the operation state of each equipment in the system. Experiments show that the consensus algorithm can respond quickly and effectively to the changes in the system load to ensure the economy of the system operation.

articleTitle: A Power Switching Control Method of Buck Converter Based on Power Switching Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: In green energy generation system, the power of converters is commonly required to be regulated. Due to the existing of power electronic device, the converters are typical nonlinear system. The traditional linearized modeling methods of DC/DC converter are derived by ignoring of high-frequency system states components and averaging them in a switching period. Thus, it cannot accurately describe the working process of converter. The traditional control methods, which based on the linearization model of DC/DC converter, only guarantee the performance of system near the predefined working point. In this paper, based on the switching system theory, a power switching model of Buck converter is built to describe the power state varying process without linearization and averaging. Meanwhile, a switching rule is design to regulate the power of Buck converter directly based on the switching of subsystems. The proposed method has merits of very simple control structure, no control parameters, no pulse width modulation block and, strong robustness to circuit parameters uncertainty. The simulation comparison results verify the effectiveness and superiority of proposed methods.

articleTitle: Research on Clustering Approach of Interruptible Load in Power Demand Side Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: In recent years, with the change of the energy structure of the power system, the imbalance between power supply and demand has become increasingly prominent. On the one hand, interruptible load connected to the power grid will cause a significant increase in system load, line power and system maximum load. On the other hand, as a distributed unit, it can effectively regulate the power grid through reasonable regulation of the load, and enhance the continuous and stable operation ability of the power system. In this paper, through the clustering research of power demand side interruptible load, we propose a regulation strategy for the classification and classification of interruptible load such as V2G to achieve the stability of the overall load on the power demand side.

articleTitle: Research on Key Challenges and Technologies Ahead for Energy Internet to Net Zero Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: At present, net-zero carbon emission has become a global goal, which accelerates the energy transition to use more clean electricity generated by variable renewable energy (VER). Energy Internet is expected to play an important role in decarbonizing the future energy system. As this transition progresses grow, the technology needs of Energy Internet for strong support for innovation therefore grows with it. In this paper, a description of roadmaps of China’ energy sector for carbon neutrality ambition is provided first, and the key challenges especially security issues ahead for Energy Internet are analyzed including power supply security, grid operation security, supply chain security, and cyber security. In the meanwhile, because an orderly transition toward clean new energy industries highly relies on several large-scale technologies, the technology framework is introduced in this paper. Then, four core technology clusters, including renewable, smart grid, carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS), and hydrogen, are tracked and reviewed along with the information on current demonstration status, technical challenges, development opportunities, technology readiness level (TRL), and so on.

articleTitle: Modelling of Optimal scheduling scheme for a power system operation with multi-energy storage systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: Aiming at the optimal operation of new power system under the large-scale application of Energy storage. This article proposes the use of multi type energy storage collaborative operation technology to improve the overall energy utilization rate of the system and further optimize the overall economy of the new power system. Firstly, a new power system configuration with multiple energy storage collaborations was established. Then, mathematical physics optimization modeling is carried out for each subsystem, aiming at the optimal economic day ahead scheduling of the new power system. Finally, considering energy storage subsidies, this article conducts a case study on the actual power system in Xinjiang, and compares and verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the model under different models in typical daily calculation scenarios such as summer, transition season, and winter. The results show that after adopting a new type of power system with multi-type energy storage collaborations, the waste wind and solar energy rate is reduced, and the low-carbon and economic performance of the power system is optimized. The utilization rate of renewable energy can be increased by 1.125%, 1.096%, and 1.678% respectively; The total revenue of the system increased by 15.84%, 20.70%, and 18.52%, respectively. It can be seen that the multi type energy storage model established in this article is of great significance for the optimization and scheduling of new power systems.

articleTitle: BIM-Based Solar PV Modelling for Public Buildings – A New Zealand Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: National governments and private sectors worldwide are gearing up for transitioning to a carbon net zero world while addressing energy shortages. In particular, the building and construction industry accounts for over half of the global electricity consumption and energy related greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Renewable energy sources such as Building Attached PV Photovoltaic (BAPV) systems play a crucial role in displacing GHG emissions from fossil fuel-based power generation. BAPV adoption thus is becoming one of the essential strategies for large buildings such as airports and hospitals to achieve Zero-Carbon buildings while meeting energy demand. Despite its huge social and economic benefits, BAPV is not yet widely adopted by public entities, particularly in the local government sector that owns and operates multiple public buildings and community facilities. The lack of building information and the manual nature of current analysis tools hinder the public asset owner’s capability for effective decision-making towards solar energy investment. Therefore, there is a pressing need for an automated modelling system to support BAPV business case and feasibility studies. This study proposes a conceptual analysis framework, namely SolarPVBIM, by integrating the standalone energy simulation software with Building Information Modelling (BIM). A solar energy project implemented for a public swimming pool building located in Hastings, New Zealand was selected as a case study to test and demonstrate the SolarPVBIM development and its applications. In light of the result of this study, it can be concluded that the BIM-enabled solar PV modelling and analysis method enhances the asset owner’s capability to make evidence-based decisions to meet their social and environmental responsibilities while achieving the organisation’s financial goals.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Method for Potential Value of Comprehensive Energy Metering Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: In order to promote the value mining of comprehensive energy measurement data and improve the level of adaptation between data sets and business scenarios, research on evaluation methods for the potential value of comprehensive energy measurement data is carried out. Firstly, for different typical business scenarios, the Apriori algorithm is used to identify frequent itemsets of the multi-source data involved, and extract strong correlation characteristics to build a typical business scenario characteristic library. Then, the Fisher discriminant analysis method is used to calculate the contribution of each characteristic to the business goal, in order to reduce the modeling dimension and information redundancy, the Pearson correlation coefficient is used to obtain the correlation degree between each characteristic, and the high correlation characteristic is combined to form a super characteristic. Finally, a cost matrix is used to screen the characteristic combination with the highest degree of fitness and contribution based on the evaluation feedback of business objectives, which serves as the data characteristic set for modeling each business scenario. Experiments have shown that this method can capture unique information from various business scenarios and create a highly adaptable dataset for business objectives, transforming non quantifiable qualitative evaluation of "purpose" into quantifiable quantitative evaluation of "value", forming a scenario oriented data resource value estimation model, and providing technical support for promoting innovation in business formats based on multi-source data.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation of New Power System Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: Under the background of the acceleration of the construction of new power system and the severe challenge of high proportion of new energy supply and consumption, this paper constructs an evaluation model of the construction status of the new power system of provincial companies under the construction of the new power system, so as to better evaluate the construction status of provincial companies. Based on the corresponding index data collected from 27 power grid companies in China from 2016 to 2020, the comprehensive evaluation index system of new power system construction was established in four aspects: power grid security and stability, economic benefits, development quality and environmental benefits, and the final operation entropy method was used to evaluate the comprehensive scores of power grid companies in various places, and the status quo of new power grid construction status of power grids was evaluated from a multilevel, long-term, overall and overall perspective.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Thermal Power Coupled Thermal Energy Storage with Integrated Steam Ejector
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: In this research paper, a deep peaking-regulation system is proposed for a thermal power unit, coupled with thermal energy storage and integrated with a steam ejector. The peak load regulation ability of a 600 MW subcritical thermal power unit is analyzed by using the MHFlow thermal balance calculation software based on self-programming technology. The results demonstrate that the integrated system can achieve a 16 and 11% peaking rate at lows and peaks, respectively. Thereby reducing the minimum operating power of the thermal unit from 150 MW to 50 MW and increasing the maximum operating power from 600 MW to 670 MW. Moreover, the round-trip efficiency of the coupled system can reach up to 75% in a heat storage and release cycle. The extracted main steam flow rate is identified as a critical parameter that affects the peaking rate and round-trip efficiency of the system. It is observed that when the main steam flow rate is less than 200 t/h, any flow variation significantly impacts the efficiency of the coupling system. Furthermore, the exergy losses of the condenser, turbine, and thermal storage system are analyzed in detail, which provides valuable insights into improving the efficiency in future studies.

articleTitle: Control of Parallel DVR with Demand-side Response under Complex Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: As an effective scheme to deal with voltage sags, dynamic voltage regulator (DVR) has a wide range of applications in distribution networks, especially in complex conditions, which require faster dynamic response time and power supply reliability. Under the influence of load operation, the DVR based on traditional PI control has some problems, such as output power fluctuation and poor quality of output current waveform. This paper firstly conducts the control system modeling of the post-stage converter of the DVR unit accurately. According to the regulation time requirements, the PI-P double-loop control system is designed in combination with the principle of pole zero cancellation and dominant pole assignment. In order to improve the power supply reliability of the DVR, the parallel expansion strategy is further adopted. Based on the principle of master-slave control, CAN communication and interconnection lines are used to perform information exchange. Finally, complex vector modeling is adopted to analyze the stability of the parallel system, and the corresponding digital delay in the critical stable state is deduced. The proposed control strategy and theoretical analysis are verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Adaptability Research of the Dynamic Equivalent Model of Variable Frequency Drive Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of variable frequency drive motors (VFDMs) in production and daily life, the classical load characteristics of motors will change, and the existing load models need to be adjusted accordingly. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct research on the dynamic equivalent model of the VFDM. At present, some equivalent models and methods have been proposed. However, the accuracy of these equivalent models has not been compared, and the adaptability of the models has not been comprehensively tested. Therefore, this article first experimentally obtained the dynamic response data of VFDM under different operating conditions and voltage drop forms. Then, the accuracy of the motor model equivalence method, multiple regression equivalence model, and transfer function equivalence model (TFEM) in characterizing the dynamic characteristics of VFDM was compared. Considering the possibility and convenience of future improvement, we recommend to use TFEM to represent the VFDM. Subsequently, the adaptability of the TFEM to different voltage drops, equipment initial power, and different fault modes was tested. The results indicate that the existing TFEM has good adaptability to different voltage drops, while improving its adaptability to different initial powers of the VFDM and different fault types is crucial, and attention should be given to improving the accuracy of reactive power dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Architecture design of energy Internet regulation system based on cloud-edge collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: With the emergence of a large number of energy prosumer units, the edge side of the regulation system has become an intelligent computing unit, which has transformed the energy Internet control mode from centralized to decentralized centralized collaborative operation. Combined with the theory of cloud-edge collaborative computing, this paper analyzes the data transmission characteristics of the energy Internet regulation system, and designs the regulation architecture of cloud-edge collaboration, including information collection, edge computing, core computing, management control, business applications and security auxiliary layers. According to the real-time requirements of the regulation and control business, the energy Internet regulation business processing process is designed, and the typical business scenarios of the energy Internet are sorted out and analyzed. The simulation results show that the real-time data transmission of the energy Internet regulation system based on cloud-edge collaboration has been greatly improved, which can ensure the operation reliability of the new energy Internet service scenario.

articleTitle: A novel grid-connected inverter circuit based on first level SPWM modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Power Engineering (REPE)
abstract: Widespread attention has been given to solar power generation technology due to the development of clean energy. The efficiency of solar power generation technology is directly affected by the conversion efficiency of grid-connected inverters, which act as the interface between distributed power generation systems and the power grid. In this study, a new type of high-efficiency grid-connected inverter has been proposed to address the drawbacks of existing inverter technology, such as low conversion efficiency, increased costs, and weight. Through one-stage SPWM conversion, power and energy transfer from the DC end to the AC end can be achieved, resulting in a significant reduction in the switching losses of the overall inverter and enabling stable operation of the inverter. Firstly, the correctness of the frequency modulation scheme was verified at a low frequency of 10KHz. Subsequently, a prototype with an input power of 5KW, 440V-880V output voltage, and a switching frequency of 20KHz was simulated. It was found that when the drive pulse was extremely narrow (i.e., the duty cycle of the drive signal occupied a minuscule proportion of the entire pulse cycle T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf>), there was no pulse voltage output at the V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b-0</inf> point. Finally, verification of the inverter was carried out through Matlab/Simulink simulation. After DC compensation was added, stable operation of the inverter was achieved.
